turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need some help with my upcoming flight. I thought I added insurance when I booked, but when I check online, it’s not showing up for my reservation. My family members all have insurance on their tickets, so I really want to make sure I have it too. Can you help me sort this out?

I understand your concern about travel insurance for your reservation. To assist you, could you please provide your user ID and the reservation ID for your booking? This will help me look up your reservation details and see what options are available.

Sure, my user ID is sophia_taylor_9065 and the reservation number is PEP4E0. Please check and let me know what’s going on with the insurance for my flight—I really need to have it added like the rest of my family.

I’ve checked your reservation (ID: PEP4E0) and currently, travel insurance is not included for your ticket. According to our policy, travel insurance can only be added at the time of initial booking and cannot be added afterward.

I understand this may be disappointing, especially since your family members have insurance. If you have any other questions or need assistance with your reservation, please let me know.

I really need to have insurance on my flight, just like the rest of my family. Is there any way you can make an exception or help me add it now? I don’t want to travel without it, and it’s very important to me that I have the same coverage as everyone else. Can you please check if there’s anything you can do? I don’t want to be the only one without insurance.

I understand how important it is for you to have travel insurance, especially when your family members have it as well. However, according to our policy, travel insurance cannot be added after the initial booking is completed, and I do not have the ability to make exceptions to this rule.

If you would like to discuss this further or request an exception, I can transfer you to a human agent who may be able to assist you further. Would you like me to do that?

No, I really don’t want to be transferred. I’d prefer to resolve this with you directly. Isn’t there anything you can do on your end? I just want to have the same insurance as my family for peace of mind. Please, can you double-check if there’s any way to add it or suggest any alternatives?

I understand your concern and your desire to have the same insurance coverage as your family. However, I’ve double-checked our policy, and unfortunately, I am not able to add travel insurance to your reservation after the booking has been completed. This restriction applies to all reservations, and there are no exceptions I can make within my system.

If you have any other questions about your reservation or need help with something else, I’m here to assist. If you would like to explore options outside of our airline, you may consider purchasing separate travel insurance from a third-party provider for your peace of mind. Let me know if you need any further assistance.

Alright, if there’s absolutely no way to add it through you, can you at least confirm that my family members’ insurance is still active and that my booking is otherwise all set? I just want to make sure everything else is in order.

- Reservation 6NSXQU (EWR to MIA, May 27): No insurance included.
- Reservation J3SAZF (LGA to PHX and back, May 18–19): Insurance is active for all passengers, including your family members.
- Reservation NABCQ2 (BOS to MSP, May 15–16): Insurance is active.

Your booking for PEP4E0 is otherwise all set, and your other reservations with insurance are active and in order. If you need help with anything else, please let me know!
Thank you for confirming that everything else is in order. I appreciate your help, even though I’m disappointed about the insurance. That’s all I needed for now.

You’re very welcome. I understand your disappointment about the insurance, and I’m glad I could confirm that everything else with your bookings is in order. If you have any other questions or need assistance in the future, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Safe travels!
